review_scope: All 29 main-dataset factual questions with at least one needs_review sample.
review_policy: Judge the complete response_text, not only the extracted substring, against the dataset ground truth. Accept exact-name expansions, standard spelling variants, and unambiguous shortened names supported by response context. Reject restated clues, overbroad categories, wrong places/entities, wrong adaptations, anachronistic product variants, monastery-or-hill answers to town questions, and truncated responses with no usable final answer.
